verdict.rationale: Notte documents Functions, which are serverless deployments of browser automations that can be invoked and scheduled. It also offers cloud-hosted web agents that act on the user's behalf, so automations can run unattended in the background. The evidence is limited to short first-party snippets. Missing for 10: detailed scheduling docs (cron syntax, triggers, monitoring/failure handling for background runs), independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled functions run reliably unattended.
